lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 10 distinct high-contrast vertical lines. Spacing is approximately equidistant across the mid-section, becoming narrower and more anteriorly slanted as they approach the shoulder region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the 4th line from the posterior, where the line splits in the lower ventral third of the torso mass.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 1st and 2nd lines from the posterior are abbreviated, terminating before reaching the mid-height of the torso. Line 4 and 5 show dashed discontinuities near the ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Low density; one primary large circular spot on the mid-haunch with 2 smaller satellite spots located inferiorly toward the upper hind limb.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white facial markings including a transverse bridge chevron between the eyes and two distinct circular spots on the lower cheek. A large white patch is visible on the ventral-anterior neck.
